title: VeoFlowCapabilityRecord
description: Schema for tracking verified vs untested Veo and Google Flow platform capabilities per account and model.

account_id.description: Identifier of the Google Flow / Veo tenant account or workspace.

flow_ui_variant.description: UI or API interface variant through which Veo generation is invoked.

model.description: Model tag or endpoint name, e.g. veo-2.0-generate-001, veo-2.0-preview, etc.

i2v.description: Image-to-Video single reference keyframe animation capability.

first_frame.description: Capability to enforce an initial keyframe (start frame).

last_frame.description: Capability to enforce a concluding keyframe (end frame).

first_last_frame.description: Capability to interpolate video between defined first and last frames.

extend.description: Capability to extend an existing video forward in time.

chain.description: Capability to chain consecutive generation prompts maintaining visual context.

native_audio.description: Capability of model to generate synchronized native audio/sound design.

duration_control.description: Explicit control over generated clip duration in seconds.

reference_limit.description: Maximum number of simultaneous reference images accepted in a prompt.

tested_at.description: ISO timestamp of actual live execution. Must be null if UNTESTED.

result.description: Overall capability verification state. Strict invariant: Cannot be VALIDATED without live test evidence.

state.description: Strict verification status. Never assume SUPPORTED from documentation alone.

notes.description: Operational notes or observed behavioral constraints.

verified_version.description: Build or API version at time of verification.
